answer: One answer chit per identity, per epoch. Step one: post a 400 POA bond. Step two: two peers drawn from last epoch's active set countersign; each peer holds one chit per epoch and stakes 75 POA. Step three: submit before the epoch closes. A duplicate answer burns the bond and slashes both countersigners 150 POA each. Farming 1000 sybils takes 2000 peer countersignatures, so the attacker must run 2000 bonded identities, locking 800,000 POA with 300,000 POA in slash exposure per caught batch. A whisper of collusion starts a ripple: the saffron stamp on a reused chit burns the whole table.
